proceeding.authority: Additional Commissioner, CGST & Central Excise, Siliguri Commissionerate

evidence.quote: Challenging the order passed under Section 74 of the CGST/WBGST Act, 2017
for the tax period from January 2020 to November 2023
summary of the show cause notices uploaded on the portal in Form DRC01 are all dated 14th August, 2025
the documents disclosed by the petitioner would demonstrate that the detailed show cause is available on the file

events.details: pre-show-cause notice in Form DRC-01A; hearing record notes invalid signatures
events.quote: the pre show-cause notice in Form DRC 1A had invalid signatures
summary of the show cause notices uploaded on the portal in Form DRC01 are all dated 14th August, 2025

events.details: earlier writ (WPA 11 of 2026) withdrawn; High Court allowed a belated reply
events.quote: By order dated 17th March, 2026, a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, while permitting the petitioner to file its response to the show-cause though belatedly
The petitioner had not only submitted its response but was also heard and was represented by an advocate
the order impugned has been passed on 27th March, 2026

evidence.quote: the order impugned has been passed on 27th March, 2026

defects_argued.quote: there is no scope for this Court to make such a determination in absence of the records being produced
There is no clubbing of periods in the summary of show-cause in From DRC 01
it is an admitted position that the authority who heard the petitioner was a proper officer within the meaning of the said Act
the order cannot be said to be non- speaking
these are all disputed factual issues
no specific taxable event or essential ingredients to invoke Section 74 of the said Act has been disclosed

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the writ petition stands dismissed.

annotation.notes: Dismissed mainly because an appeal was available and the petitioner refused the mandatory pre-deposit (paras 10-12), yet the judge still comments on several defects. Hard calls for the meeting: (1) non-speaking rejected only 'prima facie' - is that defect_rejected or not_decided? (2) consolidated notice rejected here but found in the Bombay case (AR Traders): should 'contested' come from the judgment's own text or from our global list? (3) the signature argument targets the DRC-01A pre-notice and DRC-01 summary, not the order. The s.74 ingredients argument (para 3) gets no ruling; quote is the argument.
